title: Feature scaling protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Feature scaling should complete this objective: Compare scaled and unscaled inputs. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Understand preprocessing.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: State which estimator or feature geometry makes scaling relevant.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for StandardScaler, fit_transform, train_test_split and does not run the learner code. State which estimator or feature geometry makes scaling relevant.
